<thought>To locate a suitable retrosynthetic template for the Doebner Modification, I will search the template catalog using only the functional group criteria (since the bond criteria require specific atom‑index notation that I do not have). The target product is cinnamic acid (SMILES O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1). The forward reaction consumes an aldehyde and an aliphatic carboxylic acid and forms a C‑C double bond. Therefore I will query with functional_groups_broken = ["aldehydes", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"] and functional_groups_formed = ["C-C double bonds"].</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
